rating.label: India Ratings rating
rating.summary: India Ratings and Research (Ind-Ra) has revised the Outlook on Torrent Pharmaceuticals Limited (TRP) to Positive from Stable while affirming the issuer rating at ‘IND AA+’. The affirmation reflects the revenue growth of 15% yoy in TRP’s base India business in FY26, and further acceleration in the same to 19% yoy in 1QFY27, outperforming the IPM growth of 10% and 12%, respectively, as per AIOCD PharmaTrac data.
